summary: This bill requires the Social Security Administration to ensure that all its offices are fully staffed with employees to answer phone calls during standard business hours, Monday through Friday, excluding federal holidays, starting January 1, 2027.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to improve the accessibility of Social Security services by ensuring offices are fully staffed to answer calls. While it doesn't directly expand or reduce benefits, it facilitates access to an existing social safety net program, which can be seen as a minor expansion of its effective reach or utility.
